name: Trödelmarkt Barmen Rathaus
facts: 11:00–18:00, right beside Barmen town hall in the city centre
second-hand and new goods side by side
food and drink stalls on the market
enough visitor parking in the multi-storey car parks nearby
no vehicles on the grounds between 09:00 and 17:00
notes: The organiser's Termine page renders from its own data feed on the same site (wp-json/ts-events/v1/events); dates were read from that feed. Three dates fall in the window, all second Sundays, but the organiser does not state a rhythm in words — 'one Sunday a month' is read off its own list. Nothing published for January 2027. The feed's address field says 'Große Flurstraße' while the Anfahrt text in the same record says 'Johannes-Rau-Platz 1'; used the latter, which is the town hall square, and the two are 100 m apart. 'Entry is always free' is stated on the organiser's homepage, not on the Termine page.

description.de: Ein Sonntag im Monat von 11 bis 18 Uhr direkt am Barmer Rathaus, mitten in der Stadt. Gebrauchtes und Neuware nebeneinander, dazu Essens- und Getränkestände. Eintritt frei; Parkhäuser gibt es in der Nähe, zahlreiche Buslinien halten am Rathaus.
description.en: One Sunday a month from 11 to 6 right beside Barmen town hall, in the middle of the city. Second-hand and new goods side by side, with food and drink stalls. Free entry; there are multi-storey car parks nearby and a dozen bus lines stop at the town hall.
